tools.name: conservative_readme_preprocess
tools.description: Conservatively removes HTML comments, unrelated badge-only lines, and excess blank lines while preserving all tables, headings, links, code, license, citation, model, dataset, architecture, training, evaluation, parameter, and file-format evidence.
tools.purpose: Replace the two overlapping README cleaners with one low-risk preprocessing pass.
tools.expected_behavior: Remove only high-confidence presentation noise; keep evidence-bearing badges and all substantive README lines.
tools.safety_constraints: Must not remove tables, headings, code blocks, ordinary links, license/citation badges, or lines containing extraction-relevant keywords.
tools.validation_criteria: Comments and unrelated badge-only lines are removed; license badges, tables, code, dataset text, and citation text remain.

tools.name: normalize_attributes
tools.description: Deterministic, evidence-safe field normalization for model identity, parameter units, config types, file formats, dataset identifiers, language codes, arXiv identifiers, safetensors evidence, and generic AutoModel architecture values.
tools.purpose: Restore low-risk normalization gains while keeping placeholder/evidence cleanup in attribute_evidence_guard and avoiding guessed base-model mappings.
tools.expected_behavior: Derive author/model_name from resource_id; normalize exact K/M/B parameter counts, config class suffixes, language codes, and arXiv IDs; retain GGUF/GGML file formats; resolve existing short dataset names only from unique explicit Hugging Face dataset links; reject unsupported safetensors booleans and generic AutoModel architectures.
tools.safety_constraints: Do not guess base_model IDs, do not use organization/model lookup tables, do not infer semantic values from repository names, and do not duplicate placeholder cleanup.
tools.validation_criteria: Identity derivation is deterministic; list-valued fields remain lists; safe format transformations are idempotent; unsupported safetensors/AutoModel values are removed; unrelated attributes remain unchanged.

tools.name: attribute_evidence_guard
tools.description: Final sparse-output guard that centrally removes malformed, empty, null, unknown, N/A, not-specified and other comprehensive scoped placeholder values, unsupported-evidence attributes, and duplicates.
tools.purpose: Prevent hallucinated or structurally invalid attributes from surviving after normalization while avoiding semantic value mappings.
tools.expected_behavior: Use the complete generated PLACEHOLDER_VALUES set for values and evidence; require non-placeholder evidence except for input-derived model_id/model_name/author; keep one strongest entry per field.
tools.safety_constraints: Does not infer or rewrite semantic values; input-derived identity fields are allowed without README evidence.
tools.validation_criteria: Empty/unknown values and missing-evidence attributes are removed; valid attributes remain; duplicates collapse deterministically.
